messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hello honey, it's Gloria Hart. I need the water pill...
AGENT: Hi Gloria! I'd be happy to help you with your water pill. Let me pull up your information first—can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: Oh, it's May 12th, 1947, honey. But wait, no, not the water pill, I meant the blood pressure one... lisinopril.
AGENT: Got it, lisinopril for blood pressure. Let me verify your information with that date of birth, May 12th, 1947. Perfect, Gloria. Now let me look up your lisinopril prescription. I found your lisinopril 10 mg, but it has zero refills left. Would you like me to send a renewal request to Dr. Raj Patel so you can keep taking it?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: No refills left? What do I do, honey?
AGENT: Don't worry—I can send a renewal request to Dr. Patel right now, and he should get back to us to authorize more refills. Would you like me to do that?
CALLER: Oh, yes, please do that, honey. How long will that take?
AGENT (LATEST): Let me send that request to Dr. Patel now. Great, the renewal request is sent to Dr. Patel. It usually takes a day or two for the doctor to respond, but it can vary. In the meantime, if you're running low and concerned about running out before he responds, our pharmacist can look into whether a short emergency supply might be possible—would you like me to have them call you about that?  [system actions: request_renewal]

CONDITIONS:
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Has about a week of lisinopril left"
stop_0: Agent confirms a renewal request to Dr. Patel with a timeline.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"asked_2": {"met": true, "why": "Agent asks if she's running low and concerned about running out."}, "stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent confirms renewal sent and gives 1-2 day timeline."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of hanging up or calling 911."}}
